command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
echo '=== EYE SCRATCH LAUNCH FORENSICS READONLY ==='
date -Is; hostname
echo PRODUCTION_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo '--- scratch chrome candidates ---'
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,etimes,args --sort=pid | grep -E '[c]hrome.*(eye-scheduler|go-eye|remote-debugging-port=93[0-9][0-9])' || true
echo '--- listeners 9300-9399 ---'
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:93[0-9][0-9]$/ {print}' || true
echo '--- eye-scheduler dirs newest ---'
find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'eye-scheduler-*' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -12 || true
for d in $(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'eye-scheduler-*' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -6 | awk '{print $2}'); do
  echo "=== DIR $d ==="
  stat -c 'mtime=%y mode=%a owner=%U:%G' "$d" || true
  if [ -f "$d/chrome.stderr" ]; then echo '-- stderr --'; tail -80 "$d/chrome.stderr" || true; fi
  if [ -f "$d/chrome.stdout" ]; then echo '-- stdout --'; tail -40 "$d/chrome.stdout" || true; fi
done
echo '=== END FORENSICS ==='
